decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (Location Plan: unnumbered, block plan: unnumbered, 171000309TG0S1, Design and Access Statement - Received: 9 January 2018.
'Garden Layout Plan': unnumbered - Received: 5 February 2018) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - No additional windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the walls of the outbuilding hereby approved and no additional doors inserted in the building without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 4 - The outbuilding hereby permitted shall not be occupied at any time
other than for purposes incidental to the residential use of the application property known as 13 Lionel Road North, TW8 9QZ, and not as primary residential accommodation or for business purposes, nor shall any bathroom or kitchen facilities be installed into the outbuilding without the permission of the Local Planning Authority obtained through the submission of a planning application
description: Erection of a single storey out building in the rear end of the garden for use as a studio to the house
